tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (Contabilizar, Confirmar, Imprimir), active tab indicator, links. Text in brand reads on surface and bg (5.9:1 light, 6.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of brand buttons.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a brand fill. Dark theme uses dark ink because the brand fill lightens.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active segmented filter background, info toast ground. brand text on it holds 5.1:1 / 5.9:1.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: MFW identity: safety yellow, as on warehouse floor markings. Only for the mark tile, the scan beam and the scan-ready stripe. Never text on light grounds; never a status.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text or glyph on a signal fill (11.7:1).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind panels and tables.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, forms, shell bar.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Dialogs, toasts, popovers; lifted by shadow in light, by lightness in dark.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header row, read-only fields, skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: table row separators, panel edges. Decorative only, never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input, stepper and secondary-button borders (3.7:1 light, 4.2:1 dark on surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, column headers, secondary text, units (UM) beside quantities. 6.7:1 / 7.5:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels only (4.7:1 / 5.4:1 on surface).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard and scanner focus ring: 3px solid, 2px offset. 7.8:1 / 9.7:1 on surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind confirm dialogs.

tokens.name: scan-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of a scan input waiting for a barcode (scan-ready). ink reads 15:1 / 13:1 on it.

tokens.name: scan-border
tokens.usage: Border of a scan-ready input (4.7:1 / 9.8:1 on scan-bg).

tokens.name: status-pending-fg
tokens.usage: Pending: text and hollow-ring icon. Abierto, Pendiente, Creado.

tokens.name: status-pending-bg
tokens.usage: Pending badge ground.

tokens.name: status-partial-fg
tokens.usage: Partial / in progress: text and dashed-ring icon. Parcial, Separado, Cargado.

tokens.name: status-partial-bg
tokens.usage: Partial badge ground.

tokens.name: status-partial-bar
tokens.usage: Partial segment of progress bars (4.0:1 / 7.9:1 on surface).

tokens.name: status-complete-fg
tokens.usage: Complete: text and check icon. Confirmado, Contabilizado, SM contabilizada. Blue-green on purpose, so it never pairs with error by red/green hue alone.

tokens.name: status-complete-bg
tokens.usage: Complete badge ground.

tokens.name: status-complete-bar
tokens.usage: Completed segment of progress bars (4.7:1 / 6.9:1 on surface).

tokens.name: status-error-solid
tokens.usage: Error badge fill, error toast stripe, invalid input border. The one solid status: error is louder than every other state.

tokens.name: on-status-error
tokens.usage: Text and icon on status-error-solid (6.5:1 / 7.3:1).

tokens.name: status-error-fg
tokens.usage: Error text on surface or status-error-bg: field messages, inline alerts.

tokens.name: status-error-bg
tokens.usage: Inline error alert ground.

tokens.name: status-blocked-fg
tokens.usage: Blocked: text and lock icon. Stock in quality (BESTQ Q) or blocked (BESTQ S); cancelled OT.

tokens.name: status-blocked-bg
tokens.usage: Blocked badge ground, under the hatch.

tokens.name: status-blocked-hatch
tokens.usage: 45° hatch stripes over status-blocked-bg, like a no-go floor marking.

tokens.name: warning-fg
tokens.usage: Warning text (OData message severity W): over-delivery, quantity above Máx. estiba.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning toast and inline alert ground.

families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: hh-title
styles.usage: Screen title on handhelds (one per screen).

styles.name: hh-body
styles.usage: Body text, list row primary line, input values on handhelds.

styles.name: hh-label
styles.usage: Field labels and row secondary lines on handhelds.

styles.name: hh-qty
styles.usage: The one quantity a handler acts on: stepper value, pending quantity on a scan screen.

styles.name: title-l
styles.usage: Section title on tablet and desktop.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Recepción de mercancía por orden de fabricación.
styles.usage: Default text on tablet and desktop.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text; tab labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, column headers, badge text.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Seleccione una posición en la tabla.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Material, order, OT, HU, bin and quantities in tables. Monospaced so digits align without tabular-nums.

styles.name: data-l
styles.usage: A scanned value echoed back; the expected HU/bin on a confirm step.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its field; inside chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell horizontal padding (desktop); gap between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on handheld; minimum side gutter; form grid gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding on tablet.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop; gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section separation; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page top spacing on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, bin tiles, table action buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, steppers, segmented filters (Horizon-like).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, toasts, handheld list cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Count pills inside filters and the progress bar track.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Panels and tables resting on bg.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Toasts, sticky handheld action bar.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Confirm dialogs.

size.note: Control sizes per density. Handheld sizes assume gloves: the smallest target is 56px.

tokens.name: control-handheld
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, steppers, tabs on handhelds (gloves).

tokens.name: control-tablet
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, steppers on tablets.

tokens.name: control-desktop
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs on desktop.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on handheld, including table row actions and dialog buttons.

tokens.name: icon-handheld
tokens.usage: Icon size in handheld controls.

tokens.name: icon-standard
tokens.usage: Icon size on tablet and desktop.

meta.note: The repo has no tokens; it supplied the inventory of flows, fields and sample data. All values here are new.
